content.title: Trump Rambles About Biden and Autopens to Table of Children at White House Easter Egg Roll
content.text: US President Donald Trump at a children's activity station during the Easter Egg Roll on the South Lawn of the White House. Credit : Aaron Schwartz/CNP/Bloomberg via Getty NEED TO KNOW President Donald Trump joked with children at the White House Easter Egg Roll about selling his autograph on eBayTrump accused former President Joe Biden of using an autopen during his administration, a claim that has not been verified"He didn’t sign, he was incapable of signing his name, so they’d follow him around with a big machine," the president, 79, told the kids President Donald Trump took a jab at former President Joe Biden during the White House Easter Egg Roll. On Monday, April 6, the Republican president sat down with children during the Easter celebration, signing their drawings. "I could sign autographs for you guys. And then tonight, you could sell them for $25,000 on eBay,” Trump, 79, told the children gathered around him. The children began to get excited before a few eagerly said, “Can you sign mine?” “I’ll sign,” the president replied. President Donald Trump at the White House Easter Egg Roll. Aaron Schwartz/CNP/Bloomberg via Getty Later, the president took a look at the kids’ drawings before deciding there was one he thought was especially well done. “I’m going to sign this, that way I’ll say I drew it,” he jokingly said. While signing the drawings, Trump rehashed his previous claims that Biden used an autopen during his presidency. “He’d have an autopen follow him… He didn’t sign, he was incapable of signing his name so they’d follow him around with a big machine. Do you know what it was called?” Trump said, referring to a tool that U.S. presidents have openly relied on to reproduce their signatures. “An autopen and he’d have the autopen sign for him,” the president replied. President Donald Trump among a table of children at the White House Easter Egg Roll. Aaron Schwartz/CNP/Bloomberg via Getty “He’d take the paper, hand it to his guys, sign it with an autopen and give it back. That’s not too good, right?” he continued. Trump has accused Biden of misusing an autopen during his presidency, despite the allegation never having been verified. Related Stories "Joe Biden wasn't giving those orders," Trump said of Biden's autopen use during a joint press conference with U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer in September 2025. "The autopen was illegal. It was illegally used. He never gave the orders. He never told them what to do. And I guess the only one he signed, or one of the few he signed, was the pardon for his son." "You talk about freedom of the press and freedom of speech, how about that one?" he continued. "Those people are so guilty... I know them all and they're sick people. They're smart people. They're very smart. They're probably brilliant, but they're sick in ideology and they were running the autopen. And it was totally illegal, what he did, and I hope it's going to be so adjudged." Trump later omitted a photo of Biden from his Presidential Walk of Fame at the White House. Instead, Trump put up a photo of an autopen. The Walk of Fame serves as a real-life version of the meme Trump shared in March 2025, when he posted a picture of an autopen signature framed between his two presidential portraits with the dates "2021-2025," instead of Biden's portrait. Last year, Biden defended using autopen toward the end of his presidency during an interview with The New York Times. He told the outlet that he authorized the use of autopen to sign pardons and grant clemency. "The autopen is, you know, is legal," Biden told the Times in July 2025. "As you know, other presidents used it, including Trump. But the point is that, you know, we’re talking about a whole lot of people." In March 2025, Trump also "declared" in a Truth Social post that Biden's pardons were "void." However, Trump cannot reverse Biden's pardons, legal experts told PBS.
